title: Self-Supervised Pretraining for Label-Efficient Facial Expression Recognition using Smart Glasses
abstract: arXiv:2611.05711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) on optomyographic (OMG) smart glasses such as OCOsense enables privacy-preserving, camera-free affect sensing for health and well-being. Most FER systems are fully supervised, i.e., they rely either on hand-crafted expert features with classical machine learning, or on end-to-end deep models trained from labelled data. Both depend on large quantities of labelled expressions, which are costly to collect and limit deployment in real-world, personalized settings. We investigate Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) as a route to label-efficient FER on these glasses. We pretrain a Vision Transformer with a masked-autoencoder objective on unlabelled OCOsense recordings and finetune it for five-class FER under person-independent cross-validation. translated_title: 基于智能眼镜的标签高效面部表情识别自监督预训练方法
translated_abstract: 在光学肌电（OMG）智能眼镜（如OCOsense）上进行面部表情识别（FER），可以实现保护隐私、无需摄像头的情感感知，服务于健康与福祉领域。大多数FER系统是全监督的，即它们要么依赖手工设计的专家特征结合经典机器学习方法，要么依赖从标注数据训练的端到端深度模型。这两种方式都依赖大量标注的表情数据，而这些数据收集成本高昂，限制了其在真实世界个性化场景中的部署。我们研究了自监督学习（SSL）作为在这些眼镜上实现标签高效FER的途径。我们在未标注的OCOsense录制数据上，采用掩码自编码器目标对视觉Transformer进行预训练，并在与个体无关的交叉验证设置下，针对五分类面部表情识别任务进行微调。在从5%到100%的标签预算范围内，预训练始终能提升性能；仅使用5%的标签时，预训练模型的性能就超过了从零开始训练的模型。
tldr: 该论文提出在OCOsense智能眼镜的未标注数据上，利用掩码自编码器对视觉Transformer进行自监督预训练，从而在标签极度稀缺的情况下显著提升面部表情识别性能，仅用5%的标注数据即可超越从零开始训练的全监督模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes self-supervised pretraining of a Vision Transformer with a masked-autoencoder objective on unlabelled OCOsense smart glasses recordings, enabling label-efficient facial expression recognition where the pretrained model with only 5% of labels outperforms a fully supervised model trained from scratch.
